resources.string: Unencrypted (http). Anyone on the same network can read and change what\'s sent. Only use it on your own network: on another Wi-Fi, a different device could answer at the same address.
Uses Android\'s speech recognition. Which languages work offline depends on the phone\'s settings.
Android\'s speech recognition may send your voice to its servers, so these dictations are marked as cloud. Parakeet and Whisper run entirely on this phone.
The languages you dictate in. With several, Whisper detects the language of each dictation. With one, everything is written in that language and other languages are translated.
Any server compatible with OpenAI\'s transcription API, such as Speaches, LocalAI or whisper.cpp\'s server
For example https://speech.example.com, with or without /v1. Use http:// only on your own network. An Embersay PC address that includes its key is split into address and key.
Stored encrypted, only on this phone
Which %1$s model turns your voice into text
%1$s has no speech model available right now.
The languages you dictate in. With several, %1$s picks one for each dictation, and a very short one may come out translated. With one, other languages are translated into it.
None selected. %1$s detects the language automatically.
Android\'s speech recognition uses one language. If none is selected, it uses the phone\'s language.
The languages you dictate in. With one, the server writes in it and translates other languages. With several or none, the server detects the language.
Parakeet detects the language automatically from the 25 European languages it knows. There\'s nothing to select.
To use this server\'s cleanup models, choose them in Settings → Cleanup. They work with any speech recognition.
ElevenLabs Realtime isn\'t supported. Remove this speech recognition.
A test costs the same as a dictation ($%1$s).
This deletes its settings and stored API key. Downloaded models stay until you delete them.
Bigger models are more accurate but slower. Download one, then tap Use.
A whisper.cpp model file you chose. Short dictations take longer with it.
Already downloaded a model from FUTO? Choose its .bin file and Embersay checks it.
Only choose model files from sources you trust.
You can download it again later.
Embersay can\'t dictate with it until you download it again.
A one-time download, best on Wi-Fi. While you dictate, it uses about 700 MB of memory, freed after three idle minutes.
None selected. Whisper detects the language automatically.
Recordings are only sent to a verified enclave, over a connection tied to its verified key. If verification fails, nothing is sent.
Embersay doesn\'t know which release the enclave at %1$s must come from.
This build of Embersay can\'t verify enclaves.
The enclave doesn\'t match a signed release.
The enclave\'s processor didn\'t confirm it.
The enclave doesn\'t meet the rules for a verified enclave.
The enclave\'s proof couldn\'t be fetched. Check the connection.
For comparing with Tinfoil\'s own tools.
Recognized as %1$s. Embersay knows its address and models.
This key was entered for %1$s and isn\'t sent to this address. Enter it again to use it here.
Too big for this phone\'s memory
It needs more memory than this phone has. Dictating may be slow, or Embersay may stop. You can still use it.
